product_from_film: Memelord.com combines meme discovery, editing and AI video creation.
explains_well: The film shows its own character, script, storyboard and timeline assets inside the editor, linking the pitch to its output.
unclear: Many features appear quickly, but no single user input is followed through to a finished export; the alert feature is mostly a metaphor.
scenario: Find a meme, edit it and create a character-led video.
product_clear_basis: A template grid and meme canvas give the first concrete view of the editing product.

lessons.keep: Reuse the film’s own character in the visible creation screens.
lessons.avoid: Packing several creation stages into a montage without a readable input-to-export chain.
lessons.open: Actual alert behavior, full production provenance, claimed cost, output controls and audio remain unverified.
